description: Femtoampere input bias current electrometer amplifier with integrated guard buffer
source_url: https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ADA4530-1.pdf (PDF supplied by the user; automated download from analog.com was blocked)

SOIC-8.3: IC (connect to V- or leave unconnected)

electrical.note: also max 20 fA -40..+85 C; 250 fA max at 125 C. Offset current row shows RH < 50% condition

application_notes: Pinout puts guard pins (2, 7) next to the input pins to cut PCB leakage; the datasheet has chapters on guard ring, guard plane, cleaning and handling, solder paste selection, current noise, and a photodiode interface (p38-46).

Solder flux residue degrades the low input bias performance. RMA paste is recommended; Table 7 (p38) gives IPA ultrasonic clean plus 125 C bake times to restore effective bias below 1 fA (15 min + 1.5 h for RMA).
gotchas: Bias current limit is quoted at RH < 50% and depends on cleanliness: PCB contamination can swamp the fA specification.
2 MHz GBW and 14 nV/rtHz make it a poor charge amplifier for a 33 pF diode (about 10 keV FWHM at 10 us shaping, rise about 7.5 us); intended use here is the electrometer test front end.
